title: Severe bleeding — stop the bleed
scenario: Heavy bleeding that will not stop. Blood soaking through cloth, gushing or spurting blood, deep cut or wound after injury or broken glass.
steps: Call 911, or have someone else call while you act.
Apply firm direct pressure on the wound with a clean cloth, shirt, or bandage, using both hands.
Press hard and keep pressing. Do not lift the cloth to peek at the wound.
If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top of the old layer and keep pressing.
If a limb is bleeding heavily and firm pressure is not working, a trained person with a commercial tourniquet may apply it above the wound as a last resort.
Keep the person lying down and warm until help arrives.
do_not: Do not peel off a blood-soaked cloth — add new layers on top.
Direct pressure comes first; a tourniquet is a trained-user, last-resort tool.
Do not give the injured person anything to eat or drink.
